column1: # The 49 hand-built sentences of the 2026-10 review (LEX-08: homographs yüz, gül, bin, dolu, yaşa,
# ay, determiners, genitive-possessive pairs, light verbs) with the reading the disambiguator should
# pick for each word. A sentence is `> tokens separated by spaces`; then one line per token that is
# not punctuation: word, root, exact tags. Further root/tags pairs on a line are alternatives that
# are also right. Read by tests/morphology_gold.rs.
> Bu nedenle davanın reddine karar verildi .
